section_summary.extract_value: This is an introduction section that presents theoretical frameworks for understanding the relationship between exercise motivation, body image, and body appreciation. The text discusses Self-Determination Theory (SDT) and how extrinsic goals (appearance-based exercise reasons) versus intrinsic goals (health-based reasons) relate to body image outcomes. It emphasizes the role of introjected regulation (guilt-based motivation) as a potential mechanism linking appearance goals for exercise to negative body image, particularly for women. The introduction concludes by identifying a research gap: previous research has not simultaneously examined appearance goals for exercise, introjected regulation, and body image together.
